overall: Claude reviewed commit 8d4dd5c read-only and confirmed it was a clean docs-only architecture commit with no runtime implementation. It verified the live fail-open chain: error_max_budget_usd falls through classify_peer_failure to process_failure, which is admitted to single_pilot continuation, while the existing peer-unavailable delta requires budget violations to return to the Owner. The central architecture was judged disciplined, but four specification blockers remained: unknown provider subtypes still failed open; pre-mutation critique was self-scoped by packet labels; cheaper post-exhaustion models could satisfy stronger gates; and composed evidence could leave the final frozen candidate without a complete full-suite pass.
blocking_concerns: Peer failure handling enumerated named control violations but retained a catch-all process_failure path that authorized single-pilot continuation for every unknown structured subtype.
The pre-mutation critique trigger depended on whether the packet declared peer convergence as a gate, allowing the governed author to opt out.
A post-envelope cheaper-model reroute could satisfy the original convergence, critique, or verification gate.
The test ladder allowed composed results from different fingerprints to replace a full required-suite execution on the final frozen candidate.
gaps: The fingerprint did not clearly bind untracked loadable files or stale bytecode.
Expired lease behavior without a terminal result was unspecified.
Recovered terminal peer output had no freshness limit.
Per-phase envelopes lacked a cumulative run ceiling.
Controller-observable costs were not distinguished from unobservable nested/provider context ingestion.
The task ordering did not record Owner-relayed peer review as an accepted route.
risks: Persisted terminal output lacked a dedicated at-rest secret screen, size cap, retention limit, and cleanup rule.
The orchestration state directory was not specified outside the repository.
A feature flag could disable single-flight and restore duplicate-call exposure.
The evidence store is user-writable and cannot authenticate candidate fingerprints.
required_changes: Invert the peer-failure default to an allowlist of proven benign availability failures; every unknown subtype returns to the Owner.
Trigger pre-mutation critique from objective high-impact properties and disclose every skipped critique machine-readably.
Make every post-exhaustion model reroute advisory-only for the exhausted gate.
Require one complete required-suite run against the final frozen candidate fingerprint.
Require a clean committed tree for proof reuse and bind the complete tracked tree and relevant environment.
Return an expired lease without terminal output to the Owner; do not restart automatically.
Secret-screen, size-bound, freshness-bound, retention-bound, and store terminal results outside the repository.
